values.note: Rustic sites with electric $20 a night plus tax (tent sites without electric $10, left out of the base). No museum admission is mentioned for campers.

fees.source: https://www.loggingmuseum.com/ ('Rustic Camping with electric is only $20.00 a night plus tax. Tent camping without electric only $10.00 plus tax.'; page copyright 2024-2026, season dated 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The museum asks anyone wanting to stay to call (906) 293-3700; a self check-in box takes after-hours campers. No online booking.

booking.source: https://www.loggingmuseum.com/ ('If you are interested in staying the Logging Museum Campgrounds, please call us at (906) 293-3700'; 'We have a self check-in box for after hours campers'), read 2026-10-22

note: Rustic campground on the Tahquamenon Logging Museum's 29 acres along the Tahquamenon River, ~1.5 mi N of Newberry on M-123; boardwalk and nature trail, lumberjack breakfasts in the cook shack. The site is owned by McMillan Township and run by the nonprofit Newberry Historical Restorations Association. --Claude
summary: Museum's own page: electric sites $20 + tax (tent $10), call (906) 293-3700 to stay, self check-in box after hours (fees confirmed, booking note added). Phone matches. Ownership: the history page says the site 'is owned by the McMillan Township Board of Supervisors' and the museum (NHRA, a non-profit) operates it, so `local` stands under the township-land-with-operator rule. Camping is ordinary public nightly camping; no museum admission is required of campers on the page. The museum is open May 22 - Sep 30, 2026, but the page gives no camping season, so season left. Amperage, site count not stated. Note cleaned of price, FCFS and season text.
